method: Each URL returned HTTP 200 via a Firecrawl scrape on checked_on. A reference is a research INPUT: it does not prove any statement, keyword demand or ranking. Re-check before citing; laws and advice change.
notes: The Ring Road 1 measure is a phased low-emission zone (pilot from 2026-07-01 in parts of Hoan Kiem ward; whole Ring Road 1 in 2028–2029 per the 2026-07-05 policy-portal article). Never describe it as a blanket ban from July 2026.
Decree 67/2023/ND-CP on compulsory motor-vehicle liability insurance is amended by Decree 220/2026/ND-CP (listed effective 2026-07-01). Cite both.
Japanese MOFA and the Embassy of Japan state that a Japanese-issued international permit is not valid in Vietnam; licence conversion is required.
zh: cs.mfa.gov.cn and the embassy site could not be fetched; the Beijing FAO republication of the embassy reminder is the verified substitute.

references.title: Vietnam: Reise- und Sicherheitshinweise - Auswärtiges Amt
references.covers: German Foreign Office advice whose Infrastruktur/Verkehr section warns of serious, sometimes fatal motorbike accidents involving foreign travellers (especially in Ha Giang), advises protective clothing, not leaving a passport as a rental deposit and guarding against two-wheeler theft, and also covers e-cigarette bans, crime and storm season.

references.title: Safety and security - Vietnam travel advice - GOV.UK
references.covers: FCDO safety section for Vietnam covering terrorism, protests, crime and scams, methanol poisoning, and a note that safety standards for transport such as motorbikes and buses may be below UK standards, plus seasonal flooding and tropical cyclones (page updated 2026-09-21).

references.title: Vietnam Travel Advisory | Travel.State.gov
references.covers: US State Department destination page (redirected from the old Country-Information URL) with the Level 1 'Exercise normal precautions' advisory, petty crime, landmine areas, entry and visa requirements, and local laws; the scrape summary did not surface a road-safety section.

references.title: Detalle recomendaciones de viaje
references.covers: Spanish MFA travel recommendations for Vietnam covering entry rules, health and insurance, petty crime, chaotic and dangerous traffic, disease risks, currency declaration and consular registration.

references.title: Vietnam - Informations utiles | France Diplomatie
references.covers: French MFA practical-information section whose 'Conduite routière' part says an international driving permit with the French licence is needed, vehicle insurance is required, the alcohol limit is 0 and helmets are mandatory on motorbikes, and to call police on 113 after an accident; it also covers local laws and customs.

references.title: Vietnam - Sécurité | France Diplomatie
references.covers: French MFA security section for Vietnam covering land-transport risks (dense and dangerous urban traffic, non-respect of the highway code), accidents, crime and scams, and monsoon and natural-hazard vigilance.

references.title: Honda | Xe máy | Danh sách sản phẩm
references.covers: Honda Vietnam's official motorbike range listing scooters, manual (underbone) and electric models; used only to name model families, never availability.

references.title: ベトナム運転免許への切替手続 | 在ベトナム日本国大使館
references.covers: Japanese Embassy page explaining that neither a Japanese licence nor a Japanese-issued IDP is valid in Vietnam, and setting out the procedure, documents and validity rules for converting to a Vietnamese licence (a car licence does not cover motorcycles).

references.title: 海外安全ホームページ: 安全対策基礎データ（ベトナム）
references.covers: Japanese MOFA basic safety data for Vietnam with crime hotspots in Hanoi, a 交通事情 section that urges caution with rental motorbikes, states Japan's IDP is not recognised so a Vietnamese licence conversion is needed, notes compulsory vehicle insurance is insufficient, and lists emergency numbers 113/114/115.

references.title: 해외안전여행 – 베트남 국가/지역별 정보
references.covers: Korean MOFA country safety page for Vietnam (alert level 여행유의) with recent safety notices, local emergency/embassy contacts, incident types, entry information, local culture and a 교통 정보 (transport) tab.

references.title: Reisadvies Vietnam | Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken | NederlandWereldwijd
references.covers: Dutch MFA travel advice (colour code yellow) covering crime, strict drug and e-cigarette laws, tropical storms and landslides, vehicle accident risks, local emergency numbers and embassy contacts, visa, insurance and vaccinations (modified 2026-09-09).

references.title: Trang chủ :: Petrolimex (PLX) - Tập đoàn Xăng dầu Việt Nam
references.covers: Official portal of Vietnam's largest fuel retailer (Petrolimex); starting point for current fuel grades and station information. Prices on it change and must never be copied into pages.

references.title: Vietname - Ásia - Conselhos aos Viajantes - Vai viajar? - Portal das Comunidades Portuguesas
references.covers: Portuguese MFA advice for Vietnam covering e-visa and overstay penalties, the pre-arrival form, travel insurance, drug and gambling laws, carrying a passport photocopy, avoiding night travel, and a warning not to leave a passport as a deposit when renting a vehicle.

references.title: UNTC – Convention on Road Traffic, Vienna, 8 November 1968 (XI-B-19)
references.covers: UN Treaty Collection status page: entry into force 21 May 1977, 36 signatories and 91 parties at scrape time, with the participant list, signature/ratification dates, and declarations and reservations. Vietnam's row was not checked in the scrape summary.

references.title: Nghị định số 220/2026/NĐ-CP của Chính phủ: Sửa đổi, bổ sung một số điều của Nghị định số 67/2023/NĐ-CP ...
references.covers: Government Portal record for Decree 220/2026/ND-CP amending and supplementing Decree 67/2023/ND-CP on compulsory motor-vehicle owner liability insurance; the portal listing shows it effective 01-07-2026, with the signed PDF attached.

references.title: Nghị định số 67/2023/NĐ-CP của Chính phủ: Quy định về bảo hiểm bắt buộc trách nhiệm dân sự của chủ xe cơ giới, bảo hiểm cháy, nổ bắt buộc, bảo hiểm bắt buộc trong hoạt động đầu tư xây dựng
references.covers: Government Portal document record for Decree 67/2023/ND-CP on compulsory civil-liability insurance for motor-vehicle owners (plus compulsory fire/explosion and construction insurance).

references.title: Chỉ thị số 20/CT-TTg của Thủ tướng Chính phủ: Về một số nhiệm vụ cấp bách, quyết liệt ngăn chặn, giải quyết tình trạng ô nhiễm môi trường
references.covers: Government Portal document record for Prime Minister's Directive 20/CT-TTg on urgent tasks to prevent and address environmental pollution. The scrape returned the record page, not the Ring Road 1 clause text, so editors should open the attached full text to cite the exact wording.

references.title: Công bố Đề án "Vùng phát thải thấp trong vành đai 1, thành phố Hà Nội"
references.covers: Government policy-portal article (2026-07-05) on Hanoi's announced Low-Emission Zone project for Ring Road 1. It describes a phased rollout: a pilot from 01/07/2026 to 31/12/2026 in areas of Hoàn Kiếm ward, wider controls in 2027, and the whole of Ring Road 1 in 2028-2029, rather than a blanket ban from 1 July 2026; editors should confirm hours and vehicle rules in the full text.

references.title: Luật số 36/2024/QH15 của Quốc hội: Luật Trật tự, an toàn giao thông đường bộ
references.covers: Government Portal document record for the Law on Road Traffic Order and Safety No. 36/2024/QH15 (issued 27-06-2024, effective 01-01-2025 per the portal listing).

references.title: Trung tâm Dự báo KTTV quốc gia
references.covers: National Center for Hydro-Meteorological Forecasting homepage (nchmf.gov.vn redirects here) with 24-hour and 10-day land and sea forecasts, dangerous-weather warnings (storms, heat waves), climate outlooks and flood/hydrology information.

references.title: Road traffic injuries
references.covers: WHO fact sheet: about 1.16 million road deaths a year, the leading cause of death for ages 5-29, with risk factors including speeding, drink driving, non-use of helmets and other safety equipment, unsafe roads and poor post-crash care, and the goal of halving deaths by 2030.

references.title: 中国驻越南大使馆提醒中国公民暑期注意出行安全_境外安全提醒 - 北京市人民政府外事办公室
references.covers: Beijing Municipal Foreign Affairs Office republication (2025-06-20) of the Chinese Embassy in Vietnam's summer safety reminder: complex traffic with many fast motorbikes, do not drive without a Vietnamese licence, water-activity safety, scams, and consular hotline numbers.
